_comment: Technical Design v0.38's Setting Pack: how each action is described in a character's {allowed_actions} list (block 9b), as templates; code fills the {named} placeholders. Copied verbatim from src/game/actions.ts (CC-20261111-04).
borrow: {"type": "borrow"} — take one payroll payment of {amount} {currency} from the French Embassy, which puts you on France's payroll
repay: {"type": "repay", "for": "Name"} — pay back one payroll payment, your own or a relative's who has told you of it
_before_td50_comment: TD v0.50's Retitling: `borrow` and `repay` above are TD 0.50's words; a game on an earlier TD hears these, the French pension's.
repay_before_td50: {"type": "repay", "for": "Name"} — renounce one French pension held by yourself or a relative who has told you of it
none: None available right now. Set action to null.
_errors_comment: Validation messages written into the record when a reply's action is refused.
